# How to Promote your Business on TikTok: 12 Industry Examples

[![Access social media templates](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/2235233/4d0669f4-ee64-452a-9dcc-ce4e6673cfb2.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/2235233/4d0669f4-ee64-452a-9dcc-ce4e6673cfb2)

[](https://www.sendible.com/insights/author/lizzie-davey?type=listing)

[Lizzie Davey](https://www.sendible.com/insights/author/lizzie-davey?type=listing)

17 September, 2024

9 min read

TikTok is no longer an app for scrolling through Gen Z dance challenges. In fact, the gap between the typical Gen Z audience and the millennial [audience is closing](https://thesocialshepherd.com/blog/tiktok-statistics#:~:text=Ages%2010%2D19%20are%2025,49%20is%2020.3%25%20of%20users.), allowing brands to reach wildly different demographics.

Chances are, the people you’re trying to reach are on TikTok. But how can you connect with your target audience and use the platform to grow and scale your business?

*   [Why is it important to market your business account on TikTok](https://www.sendible.com/insights/how-to-use-tiktok-to-promote-your-business#why-market-your-business)
*   [The different TikTok video formats for your TikTok business account](https://www.sendible.com/insights/how-to-use-tiktok-to-promote-your-business#video-formats)
*   [3 tips for creating engaging TikTok videos](https://www.sendible.com/insights/how-to-use-tiktok-to-promote-your-business#tips-for-creating-engaging-videos)
*   [How can you boost your business on TikTok (12 business-type examples)](https://www.sendible.com/insights/how-to-use-tiktok-to-promote-your-business#industry-examples)
*   [How to drive traffic with TikTok videos](https://www.sendible.com/insights/how-to-use-tiktok-to-promote-your-business#how-to-drive-traffic) 

And if you're serious about growing the brand's presence, you'll want to snag our [free TikTok account management checklist](https://www.sendible.com/resources/tiktok-account-management-checklist). It's designed to keep your efforts on track and ensure you're crushing it on the platform.
